plugin.name: Uysot Open API Tester
plugin.description: Backend dasturchilar uchun Uysot Open API avtomatlashtirilgan testlarini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri IntelliJ IDEA ichida ishga tushirish vositasi.
plugin.change-notes: Versiya 1.2.4 yangilanishi: - Windows uchun avtomatik Python 3 o'rnatish tizimi (PythonInstallerService) - 1-variant: Windows Package Manager (Winget) orqali avtomatik fonda o'rnatish - 2-variant: python.org rasmiy installerini (PrependPath=1) yuklab olish va o'rnatish - Windows kataloglarida Python interpretatorini chuqur aniqlash - Virtual muhit tayyorlanayotganda konsol oynasiga avtomatik o'tish
